scope: Real native Linux CPU SDK rebuild, application build and immutable recording regression

version_regression.baseline: immutable v10 schema1 execution retained in modular_v1 validation results
version_regression.candidate: v2 schema2 frontend with rebuilt v2 SDK and installed v2 profiles

limitations: Native x86 CPU regression does not exercise X5 BPU, new Stereo BIN or a real camera.
Two-frame validation recording Q8 is software regression input, not original camera accuracy ground truth.
One execution performance observations are not an optimization or speedup claim.
ARM runtime packaging fixture is separate from production ARM ROS/SDK linking and X5 execution.
